values.note: Every main-campground site has water and electric; the park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/devils-fork/camping ('59 paved sites with water and electrical hook-ups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 59 paved water/electric sites in the main lakeside campground; some take RVs up to 40 ft. Each has a 12x12 tent pad (no tents on the ground) and all units must stay on pavement; two vehicles per site, extras $20/day in overflow parking. Also 25 walk-in tent sites and 25 boat-in backcountry sites.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/devils-fork/camping ('The main lakeside campground ... features 59 paved sites with water and electrical hook-ups. Some of these sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet'; 'All campers, vehicles, trailers, motorhomes, etc, must remain on paved surfaces'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/devils-fork/camping ('Restrooms with hot showers are conveniently located in the campgrounds'; 'A central dump station is available'; 'Laundry Facility: Yes (closed December - February)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights; in peak season high-volume parks may cap the cumulative stay at 14 consecutive days. Same-day reservations go through the park (864-944-2639). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon; arrivals after 5 pm get late-arrival instructions by email.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/devils-fork/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park; check-in/out) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/devils-fork/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights', 'Arrivals after 5:00 p.m. are considered late arrivals at Devils Fork State Park'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added water hookups (amperage not stated), 59 paved RV sites up to 40 ft, showers, laundry (closed Dec-Feb), dump, 14-night max. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Not stated: amps, sewer, campground season, pull-throughs.
